reviewNotes: Reviewed all 120 exported keys from 30 cards against data/pages52.json vocabulary/furigana. Sentence questions, explanations and complete sentence answers use 1.0; heat names, texture vocabulary and short verb phrases use 0.85. Contextual は -> わ selected by exact key/occurrence; lexical はいります/はいっています/はいりすぎ, はんなま, はずして, はなして, はごたえ, はぎれ, はんのう and じょうはつ preserved. Object を -> お; no directional へ occurs, lexical へんか preserved. Exported とろとろび corrected to とろび matching とろ火(とろび) in source vocabulary. Removed trailing English What does this mean? from one Japanese audio input, preserving the original key. Katakana converted preserving long vowels/gemination: じゅーしー, めいらーど, からめる, たんぱく, でんぷん. Reviewed 糊化こか and 火入れひいれ. Added punctuation to fragments. Display labels/lookup keys unchanged. Text review only; audible articulation and pitch accent not verified.
